A region is bounded by the curve $y=-2{x}^{2}+3$ and the $x$-axis between $x=0$ and $x=1$, as shown above. Find the area $A$ of the region. Do not round the answer.

$A=$
{{field-1}}
worked_solution:
To find the area, we just need to compute the corresponding definite integral:

$$
\begin{aligned}A & ={\int }_{a}^{b}y(x)\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}(-2{x}^{2}+3)\,\text{d}x \\  & =(-2\cdot \frac{{x}^{3}}{3}+3x){|}_{0}^{1} \\  & =(-\frac{2}{3}+3)-0 \\  & =\frac{7}{3}\end{aligned}
$$
